_readme: The do-not-cite list, made mechanical. It already existed as a
convention: the banned-phrasings block in laguna:TWEET_PACK_V3.1.md, the
two NOT LOCATED sources in laguna:SOURCE_ARCHIVES_NOTES.md, and the
corrections on record in laguna:quant-floor/. Convention means somebody
has to remember. This file is the same list in a form a hook can read.
enforced     a regex tight enough to run on added text without noise.
manual_only  a rule that is real but not mechanisable without firing on
ordinary prose (for example: a code throughput figure
published without the word median). Printed every run as a
reminder, never fails the check. Recorded here rather than
dropped, because a list that quietly loses its hard items
is worse than one that admits which items are yours to
Scope: ADDED text. The check runs on a diff by default, because the list
is about what you are publishing now, and because running it on the whole
tree would fire on the archives that record the banned items in the first
place. --all exists for a deliberate audit and honours exempt_paths.

enforced.why: banned phrasing, TWEET_PACK_V3.1. We did not run a head to head against that container and must not imply one.
enforced.instead: State our own measured pair and the conditions. Comparisons need both sides measured on the same protocol.

enforced.why: banned phrasing, TWEET_PACK_V3.1. A superlative over a field nobody enumerated.
enforced.instead: Name the number, the build and the conditions.

enforced.why: figures from an X post that was NOT LOCATED by search on 2026-07-23 (SOURCE_ARCHIVES_NOTES.md). Unverified source; treated as uncitable.
enforced.instead: Similar cross-hardware comparisons exist from authors we did locate. Cite one of those.

enforced.why: the DFlash 3x-on-code / slower-on-agent-reasoning claim survives only as a paraphrase in COMMUNITY_RESEARCH.md; the source post was NOT LOCATED on 2026-07-23.
enforced.instead: Our own DFlash acceptance measurements are published and citable.

enforced.why: banned phrasing, TWEET_PACK_V3.1: nothing may imply we ran their 8,620-case quality battery. We did not.
enforced.instead: Cite our own battery by its own case count.

enforced.why: banned phrasing, TWEET_PACK_V3.1: no warm-cache latency figure at depth. Our depth latencies are cold-cache and the warm numbers were never protocol-controlled.
enforced.instead: Publish the cold-cache figure and say it is cold.

manual_only.rule: Code throughput figures are published with the word median. Peaks only with explicit conditions.
manual_only.why: TWEET_PACK_V3.1 banned phrasings. Not mechanisable: any regex broad enough to catch a bare figure fires on every table cell in the repo.

manual_only.rule: No container claim while tweet 6 is HOLD.
manual_only.why: state of an external hold, not a property of the text.

manual_only.rule: No claim sourced from the two X posts recorded as NOT LOCATED, beyond the two figure sets already enforced above.
manual_only.why: the claims are paraphrases; only their distinctive figures can be pattern-matched.

manual_only.rule: The retracted and corrected claim forms (bare cap-hit criterion, +2.64 as a cross-stack property, HumanEval/32 as a passing cap-hit, the 116/132 misparse, the depth-dose claim, the Qwen throttle, the field-name scoping, the trap 42 capability reading) are enforced by integrity/claim_propagation.py, which runs in the same job.
manual_only.why: Tried enforcing them here as well and it misfired: this check is line-scoped, and the corrections that make those citations legitimate sit on the FOLLOWING line. A duplicate rule that reports a correctly corrected paragraph as a violation is how a check gets ignored. One checker, with real multi-line context, beats two.

exempt_paths.reason: the posted claim set, kept verbatim for accountability
records the NOT LOCATED sources and must quote their figures to identify them
holds the surviving paraphrase, labelled UNVERIFIED
the corrections-on-record section quotes the superseded forms in order to retract them
the registry entry whose subject is the +2.64 confound
the registry entry whose subject is the cap-hit criterion
the originality audit and its raw archived copies of third-party material; both have to quote the banned strings to be about them
